claims.text: The three core artifacts describe one and the same trip: trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown each carry trip_id TRP-04009, and the trace's first fix (23:16:40) matches trip_record.started_at to the second, so the POL-RD-01 threshold test runs on this trip's own data rather than on any reconstruction.

The measured excess clears both POL-RD-01 establishment tests. The governing field is gps_trace.trace_distance_km, 18.96 km, not the rounded 19.0 km convenience copy on the trip_record; the booked optimal is 10.3 km, so the excess is 8.66 km, which is 84.08% of the optimal route - above the 20% test and above the 0.8 km absolute test. The gps_trace is impaired at schema level (weight 0.85, issue GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW) and I disclose that here, but it does not meet the looser policy-level thresholds in POL-RD-07, so the finding stands on the trace without independent corroboration.

The deviation is additionally MATERIAL: the excess of 8.66 km is greater than the 8.0 km materiality threshold and 84.08% is greater than the 50% threshold, so both material limbs fire and the POL-RD-06 driver_profile check is mandatory on this trip.

The single 70 second gap in the trace (23:16:50-23:18:00, bounding fixes 194.6 m apart) does not make the trace impaired for policy purposes: POL-RD-07 requires a gap over 90 seconds, a straight-line jump over 500 m, or a sustained sampling interval over 30 seconds. This trace has a 70 second gap, a largest step of 194.6 m and a 10 second median cadence, so all three limbs fail and no independent corroborating source is required. Schema-level impairment (weight 0.85) is therefore down-weighting under POL-GEN-02 only, and the deviation may be established on the trace alone.

The fare model is METERED and surge_multiplier on the fare_breakdown is 1.0, so POL-RD-02 (not POL-RD-11) governs the money. On the booked optimal route the recomputed fare is (3.80 + 0.75 x 10.3 + 0.28 x 17) x 1.0 + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP = 17.085, against a charged_total of 27.50. That is a POL-RD-02 refund of 10.415, rounded up to 10.45 - the baseline partial, and only 37.87% of the amount charged.

The POL-RD-06 pattern test is met on the citable trailing-window fields: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 4, which is 3 or more. The alternative ratio test (4/380 = 0.011 against a 0.05 bar) does not also need to pass - the clause is disjunctive - and I rely only on the two fields POL-RD-06 names, not on the lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter, which POL-GEN-01 forbids substituting for the 90-day figure.

Because the deviation is both MATERIAL and substantially substantiated on this trip's own evidence (trace, trip record and fare breakdown agree), the established POL-RD-06 pattern licenses the limb (b) uplift: FULL_REFUND of charged_total of 27.50 in place of the POL-RD-02 partial of 10.45. The uplift is confined to distance and time lines; the government and third-party pass-through lines in this fare (ERP 0.00, airport surcharge 0.00) are settled under POL-RD-09 and are not uplifted, and the ruling should print the 10.45 POL-RD-02 figure beside the 27.50 uplifted figure so the size of the uplift is auditable.

The same established pattern additionally requires the case to be referred to driver-conduct review under POL-RD-06(c). That is a referral added to the monetary ruling, not an escalation: the money still moves and the referral does not displace or delay it.

The driver's only explanation - 'night time I use expressway because faster' - is an external-traffic assertion with no evidence ID and no supporting record. The bundle holds no traffic_advisory for this trip at all: EV-ADVIS-04009-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0. Under POL-RD-13 the comparison POL-RD-03 demands cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Because the driver cites no artifact, this is not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact and POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged; the excess stands at the measured 8.66 km and the refund runs against the booked optimal route.

No rider-requested detour can be made out. POL-RD-04 requires a chat_log, and EV-CHAT-04009 is MISSING with weight 0.0 - there is no message, no waypoint_hint and no timestamped instruction to test, so the clause cannot be run and no distance is excluded from the excess. The driver's own counter-statement ('Passenger never say anything during the trip') concedes there was no instruction, so this is not the partly-corroborated contradiction POL-RD-10(7) describes and no escalation arises from it.

The remaining driver-side exculpatory routes are closed on the face of the trip record: pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-05 cannot run and no reduced baseline exists; and vehicle_type is RYDE_TAXI, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply and no pooled-itinerary collection distance is in issue. The booked 10.3 km optimal route therefore stands as the comparator.

There is nothing to add on the pass-through side and nothing to net off: the fare_breakdown carries no ERP gantries, no airport surcharge, a zero waiting_time_fee and a zero promo_discount, and payment_status is CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The whole of the contested 27.50 is distance, time, base fare and platform fee, so the full-refund uplift is not eroded by any properly chargeable statutory line.

claims.text: The whole of the rider's excess is measured on EV-GPS-04009, and that artifact is not clean. The admissibility pre-pass records it as IMPAIRED with weight_multiplier 0.85 on issue GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW — a 70-second run without fixes from 23:16:50 to 23:18:00, whose bounding fixes are 194.6 m apart at the very start of the trip. I disclose that impairment in this claim, as POL-GEN-02(1) requires. Because the deciding fact of this case — the excess distance — is carried by this one artifact and nothing else, POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence in any finding at 0.85, and the trace is entitled to the discount rather than the benefit of the doubt.

There is no second measurement of this journey anywhere in the bundle. EV-FARE-04009 bills 18.96 km — the trace figure to the hundredth of a kilometre — so the ledger carries no distance the trace does not; the trip_record's actual_distance_km of 19.0 is, on the record's own note, the same trace figure rounded to one decimal place; and EV-CHAT-04009 is MISSING at weight 0.0, so it can carry no fact at all. POL-RD-07 warns that a billed distance copied from the trace is not independent corroboration, and here every distance on the file traces back to the one impaired artifact.

The driver's explanation — that he used the expressway at night because it is faster — is on file in his statement, but it is matched by no record. EV-ADVIS-04009-01, the only traffic advisory identifier in the bundle, is MISSING at weight 0.0, so POL-RD-03's three-part comparison of a named road, a validity window and a corridor that leaves and rejoins the optimal route cannot be run against this case at all. Under POL-RD-13 that unavailability means POL-RD-03 is simply not available, and I do not ask the tribunal to treat an assertion resting on no artifact as an exoneration it cannot be under POL-RD-08. If a deviation is found, it must be found on the trace and on nothing else.

Even if a deviation is established, the FULL_REFUND uplift in POL-RD-06(b) is confined to a deviation that is 'both MATERIAL and substantiated on this trip's own evidence'. Here the materiality is reachable only through the same impaired trace, and not one of the independent sources POL-RD-07(ii) names is present: the fare_breakdown repeats the trace's own distance, the chat_log is MISSING so no admission can reside in it, no ERP gantry was charged at all, and the platform holds no independent actual_distance_km. Limb (b) is therefore not engaged on this record, and the remedy, if any, is the POL-RD-02 recomputation against the booked optimal route rather than a full refund of the 27.50 charged.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and to the driver: the route-deviation claim is upheld and the full contested fare of SGD 27.50 is refunded to the rider.

ROUTE. The governing actual distance is the GPS trace figure, 18.96 km (EV-GPS-04009); POL-RD-01 makes the trace figure govern and forbids citing the rounded 19.0 km convenience copy on the trip record for the threshold test. The booked optimal route is 10.3 km (EV-TRIP-04009), so the excess is 8.66 km — 84.1% of the optimal route. That clears both establishment tests (over 20% and over 0.8 km) and both materiality tests (over 50% and over 8.0 km).

TRACE INTEGRITY. The trace is impaired at schema level: it carries issue GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW at weight_multiplier 0.85 (a 70-second gap from 23:16:50 to 23:18:00 just after the trip started, bounding fixes 194.6 m apart). The impairment is disclosed, and the finding survives it: the trace meets none of the policy-level limbs in POL-RD-07 (gap over 90 s, jump over 500 m, sustained interval over 30 s), so it is down-weighted under POL-GEN-02 only and remains fit to establish the deviation without independent corroboration.

DRIVER'S EXPLANATION. The driver's account that he used the expressway at night because it is faster is an external-cause assertion with no record behind it. The only traffic-advisory identifier in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-04009-01, is MISSING at weight 0.0, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run and, under POL-RD-13, the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08; no advisory was on file and that explanation is discarded. No rider-requested detour arises either — there is no chat log for the trip (EV-CHAT-04009, MISSING at weight 0.0), so POL-RD-04 cannot be run — and no POL-RD-05 amendment or POL-RD-12 pooled itinerary applies.

MONEY. The fare model is METERED with surge_multiplier 1.0, read from the fare_breakdown, so POL-RD-02 applies. On the booked optimal route the recomputed fare is (3.80 + 0.75 × 10.3 + 0.28 × 17) × 1.0 + 0.80 = SGD 17.085, against a charged_total of SGD 27.50 — a POL-RD-02 partial refund of SGD 10.415, rounded up to SGD 10.45 (37.9% of the amount charged).

UPLIFT. The driver profile records deviation_flags_90d of 4 against completed_trips_90d of 380, so the repeat-deviation pattern in POL-RD-06 is established on the citable trailing-window fields. Because this deviation is material and substantiated on this trip's own evidence, POL-RD-06(b) lifts the remedy from the POL-RD-02 partial of SGD 10.45 to a FULL_REFUND of the charged_total, SGD 27.50; the two figures are stated side by side so the size of the uplift is auditable. There are no ERP or surcharge pass-through lines to carve out (all zero), so the whole contested amount is refunded.

REFERRAL. The same pattern requires the case to go to driver-conduct review under POL-RD-06(c). That is a referral riding with the money ruling, not an escalation, and it does not delay the payment.

CONFIDENCE AND EXECUTION. The deciding fact — the excess distance — rests on the single trace at weight 0.85, so confidence is capped at 0.85 under POL-GEN-02(2), above the 0.70 escalation floor. The refund of SGD 27.50 exceeds the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold, so it is issued but held for release by a human reviewer under POL-GEN-05.

Excess = 18.96 − 10.3 = 8.66 km, or 84.08% of the optimal route. THE TRACE'S INTEGRITY. EV-GPS-04009 is tagged IMPAIRED by the admissibility pre-pass, weight_multiplier 0.85, issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW: a 70-second run without fixes from 23:16:50 to 23:18:00 at the start of the trip, whose bounding fixes are 194.6 m apart. That is a schema-level impairment only. It is NOT a policy-level impairment: POL-RD-07 sets its own, looser thresholds (a gap over 90 seconds, a straight-line jump over 500 m, a sustained sampling interval over 30 seconds), and this trace meets none of the three. The deviation therefore stands on the trace, and no independent corroborating source is required. The finding survives the 0.85 discount, and the discount enters confidence only.

The excess on which this ruling turns is carried by EV-GPS-04009 at weight 0.85 (the trip record's and fare ledger's distance figures are copies of the same trace measurement, so they corroborate nothing independently). Confidence is therefore capped at 0.85 under POL-GEN-02(2). That is above the 0.70 escalation floor, so the case is decided rather than escalated.

ledger.claim: The fare model is METERED and surge_multiplier on the fare_breakdown is 1.0, so POL-RD-02 (not POL-RD-11) governs the money. On the booked optimal route the recomputed fare is (3.80 + 0.75 x 10.3 + 0.28 x 17) x 1.0 + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP = 17.085, against a charged_total of 27.50. That is a POL-RD-02 refund of 10.415, rounded up to 10.45 - the baseline partial, and only 37.87% of the amount charged.

The POL-RD-06 pattern test is met on the citable trailing-window fields: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 4, which is 3 or more. The alternative ratio test (4/380 = 0.011 against a 0.05 bar) does not also need to pass - the clause is disjunctive - and I rely only on the two fields POL-RD-06 names, not on the lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter, which POL-GEN-01 forbids substituting for the 90-day figure.

ledger.claim: Because the deviation is both MATERIAL and substantially substantiated on this trip's own evidence (trace, trip record and fare breakdown agree), the established POL-RD-06 pattern licenses the limb (b) uplift: FULL_REFUND of charged_total of 27.50 in place of the POL-RD-02 partial of 10.45. The uplift is confined to distance and time lines; the government and third-party pass-through lines in this fare (ERP 0.00, airport surcharge 0.00) are settled under POL-RD-09 and are not uplifted, and the ruling should print the 10.45 POL-RD-02 figure beside the 27.50 uplifted figure so the size of the uplift is auditable.

The same established pattern additionally requires the case to be referred to driver-conduct review under POL-RD-06(c). That is a referral added to the monetary ruling, not an escalation: the money still moves and the referral does not displace or delay it.

The driver's only explanation - 'night time I use expressway because faster' - is an external-traffic assertion with no evidence ID and no supporting record. The bundle holds no traffic_advisory for this trip at all: EV-ADVIS-04009-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0. Under POL-RD-13 the comparison POL-RD-03 demands cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Because the driver cites no artifact, this is not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact and POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged; the excess stands at the measured 8.66 km and the refund runs against the booked optimal route.

ledger.claim: No rider-requested detour can be made out. POL-RD-04 requires a chat_log, and EV-CHAT-04009 is MISSING with weight 0.0 - there is no message, no waypoint_hint and no timestamped instruction to test, so the clause cannot be run and no distance is excluded from the excess. The driver's own counter-statement ('Passenger never say anything during the trip') concedes there was no instruction, so this is not the partly-corroborated contradiction POL-RD-10(7) describes and no escalation arises from it.

ledger.claim: The remaining driver-side exculpatory routes are closed on the face of the trip record: pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-05 cannot run and no reduced baseline exists; and vehicle_type is RYDE_TAXI, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply and no pooled-itinerary collection distance is in issue. The booked 10.3 km optimal route therefore stands as the comparator.

There is nothing to add on the pass-through side and nothing to net off: the fare_breakdown carries no ERP gantries, no airport surcharge, a zero waiting_time_fee and a zero promo_discount, and payment_status is CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The whole of the contested 27.50 is distance, time, base fare and platform fee, so the full-refund uplift is not eroded by any properly chargeable statutory line.

The whole of the rider's excess is measured on EV-GPS-04009, and that artifact is not clean. The admissibility pre-pass records it as IMPAIRED with weight_multiplier 0.85 on issue GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW — a 70-second run without fixes from 23:16:50 to 23:18:00, whose bounding fixes are 194.6 m apart at the very start of the trip. I disclose that impairment in this claim, as POL-GEN-02(1) requires. Because the deciding fact of this case — the excess distance — is carried by this one artifact and nothing else, POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence in any finding at 0.85, and the trace is entitled to the discount rather than the benefit of the doubt.

There is no second measurement of this journey anywhere in the bundle. EV-FARE-04009 bills 18.96 km — the trace figure to the hundredth of a kilometre — so the ledger carries no distance the trace does not; the trip_record's actual_distance_km of 19.0 is, on the record's own note, the same trace figure rounded to one decimal place; and EV-CHAT-04009 is MISSING at weight 0.0, so it can carry no fact at all. POL-RD-07 warns that a billed distance copied from the trace is not independent corroboration, and here every distance on the file traces back to the one impaired artifact.

ledger.claim: The driver's explanation — that he used the expressway at night because it is faster — is on file in his statement, but it is matched by no record. Under POL-RD-13 that unavailability means POL-RD-03 is simply not available, and I do not ask the tribunal to treat an assertion resting on no artifact as an exoneration it cannot be under POL-RD-08. If a deviation is found, it must be found on the trace and on nothing else.

ledger.claim: Even if a deviation is established, the FULL_REFUND uplift in POL-RD-06(b) is confined to a deviation that is 'both MATERIAL and substantiated on this trip's own evidence'. Here the materiality is reachable only through the same impaired trace, and not one of the independent sources POL-RD-07(ii) names is present: the fare_breakdown repeats the trace's own distance, the chat_log is MISSING so no admission can reside in it, no ERP gantry was charged at all, and the platform holds no independent actual_distance_km.
